t_advice_summary_textbox.text: the best gnomes to pick are red blue green and brown

vb_textbox.text: Pick YELLOW or BROWN when they are on the right, PURPLE is fine for a gamble, can be high or low. BLUE and GREEN are good if you want to go for a middle of the road game as quite consistently average. RED I didn't find as good. PINK I was advised not to press so I didn't experiment with it so much.
